cards.title: Delivery Flow
cards.code:
app requests permission
app receives device token
backend stores token per installation
backend sends through APNs/FCM
app handles foreground/background tap

cards.title: Payload
cards.description: Keep payloads small and avoid sensitive data.

cards.title: Token Lifecycle
cards.code:
upsert token on refresh
associate with installation + user
remove on logout when appropriate
deactivate invalid-provider responses
cards.description: Device tokens rotate and become invalid.

cards.title: Deep Link
cards.code:
validate route type
validate identifier
authorize after app opens
fallback to a safe screen
cards.description: A notification is navigation input, not authorization.

cards.title: Preferences
cards.code:
transactional vs marketing
topic-level opt-ins
quiet hours
time zone
channel selection
cards.description: Respect platform permission and in-app preferences.

cards.title: Idempotent Send
cards.code:
notification_key = event_id + user_id + channel
unique constraint prevents duplicate enqueue
cards.description: Retries should not spam the user.

cards.title: Delivery Reality
cards.code:
not guaranteed
may be delayed
may be collapsed
app may be terminated
user may disable permission
cards.description: The app must synchronize authoritative state after opening.

cards.title: Measure the Funnel
cards.code: eligible -> queued -> provider accepted -> delivered when available -> opened -> action
cards.description: Separate provider acceptance from actual delivery.
